projection: Approximate XY campus transform in modular/AGENTS.md; not surveyed

height.basis: GIS Extrution=45 interpreted as feet; units are not declared by source layer

floor_count.basis: GIS NUM_LEVELS=6 with F01-F04 floor fields; B and G are included in total count but not split into additional visible window rows because the layer does not define their datum, units, or above/below-grade relationship
floor_count.measurement_status: source attribute and explicit modeling interpretation; not independently checked against measured plans

facade.basis: Purdue Archives historic photographs dated September 14, 1959 and undated, IDs 1371-1374
facade.status: photo-based interpretation; exact current facade dimensions unverified

limitations: GIS polygon is an official campus GIS footprint, not a certified survey.
Height unit is absent from GIS schema; 45 ft is an estimate, not a measurement.
Photographic facade details are from archival 1959 views; current renovations may differ.
No detailed elevations or certified measured drawings were found in the evidence set.
